job.job_title: Full Stack Developer Python FastAPI ReactJS
job.job_description:
Full Stack Developer (Python + FastAPI + ReactJS)
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

Full Time, Work From Office

About the Role

We re looking for a Python Fullstack Developer who s passionate about building scalable web products and working across both backend and frontend. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, especially in the ad tech or payments domain, and embraces the use of AI-assisted development tools to boost productivity. You ll work in a collaborative Agile environment, integrating third-party APIs, deploying applications on cloud infrastructure, and delivering high-performance solutions.

Requirements

Location: Chennai
Experience: 5 to 8 years
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days
Department: Engineering Full Stack Development
Qualification: Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field







Must-Have Skills:




Python with FastAPI for backend development

Strong proficiency in ReactJS and frontend development best practices

Experience integrating Google/Meta Ads APIs, Stripe, or subscription systems

Hands-on use of AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, TabNine)

API integration and secure coding practices

Ability to build scalable and maintainable architectures




Key Responsibilities:




Design and build end-to-end web applications using Python and ReactJS

Integrate third-party APIs for ads, payments, or subscription flows

Build and manage infrastructure on cloud platforms (GCP preferred)

Optimize code for performance, scalability, and user experience

Leverage AI tools to accelerate development workflows

Collaborate closely with product, UI/UX, and QA teams in an Agile setup

Maintain clean code, follow coding standards, and participate in peer reviews




Good to Have:




Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows

Strong understanding of microservices and modern software architecture

Passion for clean, testable, and maintainable code

Self-driven attitude with a learning mindset and ownership mentality

About the Company

Work with a company making a real impact in the healthcare tech space driving smarter solutions, better care, and innovation that matters.
